projects.label: Selected work
projects.title: From a need to a working solution.
projects.description: Professional projects where I contributed to development, technical decisions and product evolution.

support.title: Customer support connected to WhatsApp
support.context: An internal customer support platform with automations to support Nordsol's communication workflows.
support.contribution: I developed the application with Next.js and Nest.js, integrated n8n automations and containerized the application with Docker. I worked with UI/UX on the experience for customers and the internal team.
support.result: The platform enabled the company to eliminate spending on third party software used for customer support.

referrals.title: Referrals that create opportunities
referrals.context: A lead referral system to support customer acquisition at Nordsol.
referrals.contribution: I led development with React, Node.js and PostgreSQL. I designed the architecture to accommodate new business rules and wrote tests for each new feature.
referrals.result: An internal referral system, with tests to support stability and a structure designed for further development.

legal.title: Evolving a legal management platform
legal.context: A legal management platform at Sun4 with legacy components and a need for ongoing development.
legal.contribution: I worked on refactoring with React and Next.js, implemented state management with Zustand, and contributed to TypeScript standardization and code reviews.
legal.result: I also built CI/CD pipelines integrated with GitHub, automating tests and deployments to shorten the path from development to production.
